summary: Emma Long, 23, of Houston, Texas, reported overdue in the Longs Peak area; had fallen above the Keyhole within the prior 24 hours and suffered serious injuries; RMNP SAR team members and park visitors litter-carried her to the Boulder Field, where a Flight For Life helicopter flew her to St. Anthony's Hospital in Denver
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain National Park Search and Rescue; Flight For Life Air Ambulance
notes: Separate rescue conducted during the search for Jens 'Jay' Yambert; NPS release dated 2018-08-30.
